diseases.symptoms: Rectangular, brown to gray necrotic lesions running parallel to leaf veins; lesions merge causing extensive blighting.
diseases.treatment: Plant certified resistant hybrid maize varieties; rotate with legumes (soybean, cowpea); apply azoxystrobin or mancozeb fungicide at early tasseling if infection is severe.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shuka nau'ikan masara masu juriya; canza shuka da wake ko waken soya; fesa maganin mancozeb a lokacin fitar fure idan cutar ta yi tsanani.
diseases.treatment_yo: Gbin awọn irugbin agbado to ni idaabobo; paarọ gbingbin pẹlu ẹwa tabi ewa soya; lo oogun mancozeb nigbati agbado ba bẹrẹ si tan itanna.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kụọ ụdị ọka na-eguzogide ọrịa; gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ na agwa; gbaa ọgwụ mancozeb mgbe ọka na-epu ifuru ma ọ bụrụ na ọrịa ahụ dị ukwuu.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Plant resistant maize hybrid; rotate farm with beans or soya; spray mancozeb fungicide when maize start to flower if the sickness plenty.

diseases.symptoms: Small, powdery brown to reddish-brown pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces; foliage yellows and dies back prematurely.
diseases.treatment: Plant resistant maize hybrids (e.g. Oba Super series); ensure balanced nitrogen-potassium fertilisation; apply triazole or mancozeb fungicide if rust appears before silking in humid weather.
diseases.treatment_ha: Shuka nau'ikan masara masu juriya kamar Oba Super; tabbatar da daidaiton taki; fesa maganin mancozeb idan tsatsa ta fito kafin fitar gashin masara.
diseases.treatment_yo: Gbin orisirisi agbado to lodi si arun bii Oba Super; lo ajile to peye; lo oogun mancozeb ti ipata ba ti han ki agbado to gbọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kụọ ụdị ọka na-eguzogide dị ka Oba Super; tinye ezigbo ajịle; gbaa ọgwụ mancozeb ma nchara pụta tupu ọka amịchaa.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Plant strong maize variety like Oba Super; put correct fertilizer; spray mancozeb if red powder rust show for leaf before corn mature.

diseases.symptoms: Long, elliptical cigar-shaped grayish-green to tan lesions on leaves; severe infection causes complete foliage scorching.
diseases.treatment: Destroy or deep-plough crop residues after harvest; practice 2-year crop rotation away from cereals; apply azoxystrobin or copper-based fungicide at onset of symptoms.
diseases.treatment_ha: Kone ko binne ragowar shuka bayan girbi; canza shuka na tsawon shekaru 2; fesa maganin mancozeb ko na jan karfe idan alamun suka bayyana.
diseases.treatment_yo: Sun tabi sin gbogbo eku agbado lẹhin ikore; yi iru ohun ọgbin pada fun ọdun 2; lo oogun fungisidi to ni kọpa lẹsẹkẹsẹ ti aisan ba bẹrẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kpọọ ọkụ ma ọ bụ lie ahihia mgbe e wechara ihe ubi; zere ịkụ ọka n'otu ala ruo afọ abụọ; gbaa ọgwụ copper mgbe ọrịa pụtara.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Burn or bury dry maize stalks after harvest; no plant corn for the same farm for two years; spray copper fungicide as soon as sick spots show.

diseases.symptoms: Leaves are vibrant uniform green without lesions, pustules, or wilting. Vigorous stalk and tassel growth.
diseases.treatment: No treatment required. Maintain proper plant spacing (75cm x 25cm), apply split urea top-dressing at 4 and 8 weeks, and scout weekly.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da ba da tazarar shuka da ta dace, a zuba takin urea a mako na 4 da na 8, kuma a duba gonar mako-mako.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko nilo oogun kankan. Tọju aaye to peye laarin awọn ohun ọgbin, lo ajile urea ni ọsẹ 4 ati 8, ki o si maa ṣayẹwo oko rẹ ni ọsẹ kọọkan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Debe ezigbo ohere n'etiti ọka, tinye ajịle urea n'izu nke anọ na nke asatọ, ma na-elele ubi kwa izu.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No need medicine. Maintain correct spacing for farm, put urea fertilizer at 4 weeks and 8 weeks, make you inspect farm every week.

diseases.symptoms: Asymmetric blotchy yellowing on leaves with vein corking; lopsided, small, bitter fruit that stays green at the bottom.
diseases.treatment: Remove and burn severely infected trees to prevent spreading to entire orchard; control citrus psyllid insect vectors with neem oil or imidacloprid; plant only certified clean disease-free seedlings.
diseases.treatment_ha: Cire da kona bishiyoyin da suka kamu sosai; shafe kwari masu yada cutar da man neem ko maganin kwari; shuka tsaba masu lafiya kawai.
diseases.treatment_yo: Yọ ki o si sun awọn igi ti o ni aisan pupọ; pa awọn kokoro ti n tan aisan pẹlu epo neem; gbin awọn irugbin to ni ilera nikan.
diseases.treatment_ig: Wepụ ma kpọọ ọkụ osisi ndị butere ọrịa ahụ; gbuo ụmụ ahụhụ na-agbasa ọrịa site na mmanụ neem; kụọ naanị ezigbo mkpụrụ dị mma.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Cut down and burn sick orange trees make e no spread; kill the insects wey dey carry the sickness with neem oil spray; plant only clean seedlings.

diseases.symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown with yellow halos; severe leaf drop exposing fruit to sunscald.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide/fungicide every 7-10 days in wet conditions; avoid overhead irrigation; practice 3-year crop rotation.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa maganin jan karfe kowane kwana 7-10 a lokacin damina; guji zuba ruwa a saman ganye; canza shuka na tsawon shekaru 3.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo oogun kọpa ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10 nigba ojo; yago fun fífún omi si ori ewéko; yi ohun ọgbin pada fun ọdun 3.
diseases.treatment_ig: Tinye ọgwụ copper kwa ụbọchị 7-10 n'oge udu mmiri; zere ịwụnye mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ; gbanwee ebe ị na-akụ ose kwa afọ 3.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray copper fungicide every 7-10 days when rain dey fall; no pour water on top leaves; rotate the farm with other crops for 3 years.

diseases.symptoms: Uniform dark green foliage, vigorous blossom set, smooth unblemished fruit.
diseases.treatment: No treatment required. Maintain steady watering, weed regularly, and mulch to retain soil moisture.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu bukatar magani. Ci gaba da ban ruwa akai-akai, cire ciyawa, kuma a sanya ciyawar ciyawa don rike danshi.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko nilo oogun. Maa bu omi fun ọgbin rẹ deedee, ro oko ki o si fi koriko bo ilẹ lati daabo bo omi ninu erupẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Na-agba mmiri mgbe niile, na-akwọcha ahihia, ma na-ekpuchi ala ka mmiri ghara ịkpọ nkụ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No need medicine. Water your pepper well, clear grass from farm, put dry grass for ground make water remain.

diseases.symptoms: Dark brown, target-shaped spots with concentric rings on older leaves; yellowing and early vine death.
diseases.treatment: Apply mancozeb or chlorothalonil fungicide every 7-10 days; practice 3-year crop rotation; avoid overhead irrigation.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa mancozeb kowane kwana 7-10; canza shuka na tsawon shekaru 3; guji zuba ruwa daga sama.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo oogun mancozeb ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10; yi ohun ọgbin pada fun ọdun 3; yago fun fífún omi lati oke.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gbaa mancozeb kwa ụbọchị 7-10; gbanwee ihe ọkụkụ kwa afọ 3; zere ịgba mmiri n'elu.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray mancozeb fungicide every 7-10 days; rotate farm for 3 years; no pour water on top leaves.

diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves and stems; white mildew underneath in damp weather; tuber rot with brown dry flesh.
diseases.treatment: Spray systemic metalaxyl-mancozeb (Ridomil) immediately upon detection; harvest tubers only in dry weather; store in cool dry conditions.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa maganin Ridomil nan take; girbi dankali a lokacin rani; adana a wuri mai sanyi da bushewa.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo oogun Ridomil lẹsẹkẹsẹ; ko ọdunkun nikan nigba ti ilẹ ba gbẹ; tọju si ibi ti o tutu ti o si gbẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gbaa Ridomil ozugbo; gwupụta nduku mgbe anwụ na-acha; chekwaa n'ebe dị jụụ ma kpọọ nkụ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray Ridomil fungicide immediately; harvest potato when ground dry; store for cool dry place.

diseases.symptoms: Lush green foliage, thick sturdy stems, vigorous flowering.
diseases.treatment: No treatment required. Hill soil around stems to protect developing tubers from sun and pests; maintain even moisture.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu bukatar magani. Tara kasa a kusa da kututturan shuka don kare dankali daga rana da kwari; a kiyaye danshi.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko nilo oogun. Ko erupẹ yika ẹsẹ ọgbin lati daabobo ọdunkun lọwọ oorun ati kokoro; jẹ ki ilẹ tutu deedee.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Kpọkọta aja gburugburu osisi iji chebe nduku pụọ na anwụ na ụmụ ahụhụ; na-agba mmiri mgbe niile.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No need medicine. Gather soil round the stems make sun no touch potato; keep soil wet small small.

diseases.symptoms: Dark brown circular spots with yellow halos on leaves; scabby raised blisters on fruit; premature defoliation.
diseases.treatment: Apply copper hydroxide spray mixed with mancozeb weekly; sanitize stakes and farm tools with bleach; remove infected lower leaves.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa maganin copper da mancozeb kowane mako; wanke kayan aiki da bleach; cire ganyen da suka kamu a kasa.
diseases.treatment_yo: Lo oogun kọpa ati mancozeb ni ọsẹ kọọkan; fi omi jik fọ awọn ohun elo iṣẹ; yọ awọn ewé aisan kuro ni isalẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gbaa ọgwụ copper na mancozeb kwa izu; were bleach sachaa ngwa ọrụ; wepụ akwụkwọ ndị butere ọrịa n'ala.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray copper and mancozeb fungicide every week; wash your farm tools with bleach; cut the sick leaves wey dey touch ground.

diseases.symptoms: Concentric target-like brown rings on older leaves; yellowing surrounding the spots; dark leathery stem cankers.
diseases.treatment: Prune lower leaves to improve airflow; mulch soil to prevent rain splash; apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb every 7-14 days.
diseases.treatment_ha: Yanke ganyen kasa don shigar iska; sanya ciyawa a kasa don hana watsar ruwa; fesa mancozeb kowane kwana 7-14.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ge awọn ewe isalẹ lati gba afẹfẹ wọle; fi koriko bo ilẹ ki ojo ma ba fọ erupẹ si ewe; lo oogun mancozeb ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-14.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kpụchaa akwụkwọ ndị dị n'ala; kpuchie ala ka mmiri ozuzo ghara ịtụba aja n'akwụkwọ; gbaa mancozeb kwa ụbọchị 7-14.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Prune leaves wey dey near ground make air enter; put dry grass for ground make splash no carry germ; spray mancozeb every 1-2 weeks.

diseases.symptoms: Large, irregular water-soaked pale green to dark brown lesions; white fuzzy mold on leaf undersides in humid conditions; rapid vine rot.
diseases.treatment: Immediately spray systemic fungicide like metalaxyl-mancozeb (Ridomil Gold); remove and destroy severely infected vines; avoid overhead watering.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa maganin Ridomil Gold nan take; cire da kona dukkan rassan da suka kamu sosai; guji zuba ruwa a saman ganye.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fún oogun Ridomil Gold lẹsẹkẹsẹ; yọ ki o si sun awọn ẹka ti o ti bàjẹ́; yago fun fífún omi si ori ewéko.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gbaa ọgwụ Ridomil Gold ozugbo; wepụ ma kpọọ ọkụ osisi ndị mebiri emebi; zere ịwụsa mmiri n'elu akwụkwọ.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray Ridomil Gold fungicide immediately; burn the plant parts wey don rot well well; no pour water on top tomato leaves.

diseases.symptoms: Pale greenish-yellow patches on upper leaf surface, with dense olive-green to purple-brown velvety mold on undersides.
diseases.treatment: Improve greenhouse and field ventilation; increase plant spacing; spray copper fungicide or chlorothalonil every 7-10 days.
diseases.treatment_ha: Inganta iska a gonar; kara tazarar shuka; fesa maganin jan karfe kowane kwana 7-10.
diseases.treatment_yo: Muu afẹfẹ wọle si oko daadaa; fi aaye to tobi laarin awọn ọgbin; lo oogun kọpa ni gbogbo ọjọ 7-10.
diseases.treatment_ig: Mee ka ikuku na-eku nke ọma n'ubi; mụbaa ohere dị n'etiti osisi; gbaa ọgwụ kọpa kwa ụbọchị 7-10.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Make sure air dey flow well for farm; give plants enough space; spray copper fungicide every 7-10 days.

diseases.symptoms: Numerous small circular brown spots with gray or tan centers and dark borders; tiny black fruiting bodies inside spots.
diseases.treatment: Remove infected lower leaves; mulch to prevent soil splashing; apply mancozeb or copper-based fungicide every 7 days.
diseases.treatment_ha: Cire ganyen da suka kamu a kasa; sanya ciyawa don hana feshin kasa; fesa mancozeb ko na jan karfe kowane kwana 7.
diseases.treatment_yo: Yọ awọn ewé to ní aisan kuro ni isalẹ; fi koriko bo erupẹ; lo oogun mancozeb tabi kọpa ni gbogbo ọjọ 7.
diseases.treatment_ig: Wepụ akwụkwọ ndị butere ọrịa n'ala; kpuchie ala ka mmiri ghara ịwụsa aja; gbaa ọgwụ mancozeb kwa ụbọchị 7.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Cut sick leaves from bottom; cover ground with grass; spray mancozeb or copper fungicide every 7 days.

diseases.symptoms: Yellow stippling or bronzing on leaves; fine silky webbing visible on undersides; leaves dry up and turn brown.
diseases.treatment: Spray leaf undersides with insecticidal soap or neem oil (50ml/10L water); apply acaricide like Abamectin for severe infestations; keep plants hydrated.
diseases.treatment_ha: Fesa kasan ganye da man neem ko sabulun kwari; yi amfani da Abamectin idan kwari sun yi yawa; a kiyaye danshi a gonar.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fún abẹ ewé pẹlu epo neem tabi ọṣẹ apakokoro; lo oogun Abamectin ti kokoro ba pọju; fun awọn ọgbin ni omi to peye.
diseases.treatment_ig: Gbaa mmanụ neem ma ọ bụ ncha kwụsịrị ụmụ ahụhụ n'okpuru akwụkwọ; jiri Abamectin mee ihe; na-agba mmiri mgbe niile.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Spray under the leaves with neem oil or soap water; use Abamectin medicine if the mites plenty well well; water your plants well.

diseases.symptoms: Brown pinpoint lesions that expand to circular spots with concentric rings; leaves yellow and drop prematurely.
diseases.treatment: Improve air circulation through staking and pruning; apply azoxystrobin or mancozeb fungicide at first sign of spots.
diseases.treatment_ha: Inganta shigar iska ta hanyar daure shuka da yanke rassa; fesa mancozeb idan dige-dige suka bayyana.
diseases.treatment_yo: Di awọn ọgbin mọ igi ki o si ge ẹka lati jẹ ki afẹfẹ wọle; lo oogun mancozeb lẹsẹkẹsẹ ti aami ba ti han.
diseases.treatment_ig: Kekọta osisi n'elu mkpara ma bepụ alaka ka ikuku baa; gbaa mancozeb mgbe ntụpọ pụtara.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Tie tomato up with sticks and prune make air enter; spray mancozeb fungicide as soon as you see target spots.

diseases.symptoms: Severe stunting, erect bushy growth; leaf edges curl upward and turn yellow; dramatic drop in fruit production.
diseases.treatment: Uproot and bury infected plants immediately (no chemical cure); spray weekly with neem oil to control whitefly vector; use fine insect netting in nursery.
diseases.treatment_ha: Tumɓuke da binne tsirrai masu cuta nan take; fesa man neem kowane mako don magance farar kuda; yi amfani da raga mai kariya.
diseases.treatment_yo: Fa awọn ọgbin ti o ni aisan tu ki o si sin wọn sinu ilẹ; lo epo neem ni gbogbo ọsẹ lati pa awọn fo funfun; lo àwọ̀n kọkọrọ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Hopụta ma lie osisi ndị na-arịa ọrịa ozugbo; were mmanụ neem gbuo ụmụ ahụhụ na-efe efe; jiri ụgbụ gbachie ebe ị na-azụ nwa osisi.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Pull out and bury sick tomato plants immediately; spray neem oil every week to kill whitefly; use net cover for nursery.

diseases.symptoms: Mottling with alternating light and dark green areas on leaves; leaf crinkling or stringy 'shoestring' distortion; uneven fruit ripening.
diseases.treatment: Rogue and destroy infected plants; disinfect hands and tools with milk or 10% bleach before handling plants; never smoke or handle tobacco near tomatoes.
diseases.treatment_ha: Cire da lalata tsirrai masu cuta; wanke hannu da kayan aiki da madara ko bleach; kada a taba taba kusa da tumatir.
diseases.treatment_yo: Yọ ki o si pa gbogbo ọgbin ti aisan ti kọlu; fi ọṣẹ tabi wàrà wẹ ọwọ ati ohun elo ṣaaju ki o to fọwọ kan ọgbin; ma mu siga nitosi tumato.
diseases.treatment_ig: Wepụ ma mebie osisi ndị butere ọrịa; were ncha ma ọ bụ mmiri ara ehi sachaa aka na ngwa ọrụ; anụla anwụrụ nso tumato.
diseases.treatment_pcm: Pull out and burn sick tomato plants; wash your hands with soap or milk before touching plants; no smoke cigarette near your tomato farm.

diseases.symptoms: Vibrant green leaves, sturdy stems, active flowering, smooth firm developing fruit.
diseases.treatment: No treatment required. Stake plants, water at the soil base, apply calcium nitrate to prevent blossom end rot, and scout weekly.
diseases.treatment_ha: Babu bukatar magani. Daure shuka da itace, ba da ruwa a gindin shuka, zuba takin calcium don hana rubewar kasan tumatir, kuma a duba gonar mako-mako.
diseases.treatment_yo: Ko nilo oogun. So ọgbin rẹ mọ igi, bu omi si isalẹ erupẹ nikan, lo ajile calcium lati dena ibajẹ eso, ki o si maa ṣayẹwo oko rẹ.
diseases.treatment_ig: Ọ dịghị ọgwụ dị mkpa. Kekọta osisi n'elu mkpara, na-agba mmiri n'ala naanị, tinye calcium ka mkpụrụ ghara ire ure, ma na-elele ubi kwa izu.
diseases.treatment_pcm: No need medicine. Tie plants to sticks, pour water for soil bottom only, put calcium fertilizer make tomato bottom no spoil, check farm weekly.
